title: Correcting the Logic Behind the 2026 US Vehicle Emissions Standard Rollback
Impacts from Sector-Specific Energy Policies on Mortality Co-Benefits and Socioeconomic Disparities Across Three Midwestern States in the Year 2050
abstract: Assessments on effects of policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions have shown wide-ranging health and exposure co-benefits in the United States (U.S.). However, the benefits of these policies may not be shared equally, and few studies have investigated differences in impacts across populations. We estimated exposure, health, and monetary benefits for various sociodemographic subpopulations, under several environmental justice indices, across three midwestern states (Illinois, Indiana, Ohio) at the census tract level. We estimated changes to fine particulate matter (PM 2.5 ) concentrations across three sector-specific energy policy scenarios (high natural gas use, high electric vehicle uptake, building energy efficiency) and a business-as-usual policy case. Health impact function analyses were used to determine census-tract level changes in mortality, and value of statistical life (VSL) was used to determine the associated monetary impacts. All energy policies were estimated to reduce PM 2.5 concentrations in 2050 compared to 2010 reference levels (1.55 to 1.70 μg/m 3 across policy projections, with avoided mortalities of 6010 (95% confidence interval 4093, 7396) to 6560 (4469, 8072), and mortality savings of $69.115 to $75.440 billion, with cost per capita between $2,456 and $2,681). Several subpopulations, including those with high educational isolation, the Black population, and those making <$75,000/year, had higher baseline expected mortality and higher projected avoided mortality compared to the overall population, indicating strong benefits for these groups. Our findings highlight the ability of climate change mitigation strategies to reduce exposure and mortalities in the Midwestern U.S. while directly benefitting certain disadvantaged populations.
abstract_zh: 关于减少温室气体排放政策效果的评估，已在美国显示出广泛的健康和暴露协同效益。然而，这些政策的效益可能并非平等地惠及所有人，而很少有研究考察不同人群之间影响的差异。我们在人口普查区层面，估算了伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州和俄亥俄州三个中西部州内各类社会人口亚群体，在若干环境正义指数下的暴露、健康和货币效益。我们估算了三种分行业能源政策情景（高天然气使用、高电动汽车普及以及建筑能效）和一项照常情景下细颗粒物（PM 2.5）浓度的变化。我们采用健康影响函数分析来确定人口普查区层面死亡率的变化，并利用统计生命价值（VSL）来确定相关的货币影响。所有能源政策都估计在2050年相比2010年的参考水平降低了PM 2.5浓度（各政策预测下为1.55至1.70微克/立方米），避免死亡人数为6010例（95%置信区间为4093至7396）至6560例（4469至8072），死亡相关节省为691.15亿至754.40亿美元，人均成本在2,456美元至2,681美元之间。若干亚群体，包括教育隔离程度高的群体、黑人群体以及年收入低于75,000美元的群体，相较于总体人口，其基线预期死亡率更高，预计避免的死亡人数也更多，表明这些群体将获得显著收益。我们的研究结果凸显了气候变化缓解策略在降低美国中西部地区暴露和死亡率方面的能力，同时也直接惠及某些弱势群体。

title: Racial Disparities in the Health Effects from Air Pollution: Evidence from Ports
abstract: This study examines the uneven effects of air pollution from maritime ports on physical and mental health across racial groups. We exploit quasi-random variation in vessels in port from weather events far out in the ocean to estimate how port traffic influences air pollution and human health. We find that one additional vessel in a port over a year leads to 3.1 hospital visits per thousand Black residents within 25 miles of the port and only 1.1 per thousand for Whites. We assess a port-related environmental regulation and show that the policy can help alleviate racial inequalities in health outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了海港的空气污染对不同种族群体身体和心理健康的不均衡影响。我们利用远海天气事件造成的入港船只准随机变异，来估计港口交通如何影响空气污染和人类健康。我们发现，一年内港口每增加一艘船，港口25英里范围内每千名黑人居民的医院就诊次数增加3.1次，而白人居民仅增加1.1次。我们评估了一项与港口相关的环境监管，结果表明该政策有助于缓解健康结果方面的种族不平等。

title: Will Pickup Buyers Go Electric?
Strategic Avoidance and the Welfare Impacts of U.S. Solar Panel Tariffs
abstract: This study examines the effects of tariffs imposed by the U.S. on imported solar panels. We first provide clear evidence that tariff-exposed firms shifted production to locations that did not face tariffs, and that domestic prices increased relative to other markets. We then develop a structural model to analyze welfare effects. We find that the tariffs generated modest gains for domestic manufacturers and for government revenues, but larger losses in domestic consumer surplus and environmental benefits, thereby reducing domestic welfare. Furthermore, the tariffs reduced domestic solar industry employment and wages. By contrast, subsidizing solar panel manufacturing could increase domestic production, employment, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了美国对进口太阳能电池板加征关税的影响。我们首先提供了明确证据，表明受关税影响的企业将生产转移至未被征税的地区，且国内价格相对于其他市场有所上涨。随后，我们构建了一个结构模型以分析福利效应。我们发现，关税为国内制造商和政府收入带来了适度收益，但国内消费者剩余和环境效益的损失更大，从而降低了国内福利。此外，关税减少了国内太阳能产业的就业和工资。相比之下，对太阳能电池板制造进行补贴可能会增加国内产量、就业和福利。

title: Valuing Solar Subsidies
abstract: Individuals trade present for future consumption across a range of economic behaviors, and this tradeoff may differ across socioeconomic groups. To assess these tradeoffs, we estimate a dynamic model of residential solar adoption and system sizing in California using household-level data on solar irradiance, electricity consumption, and electricity rates that offer plausibly exogenous variation in the future benefits from adopting relative to upfront costs. We find implicit discount rates of 15.3%, 13.8%, and 10.0% for low-, medium-, and high-wealth households. Counterfactual simulations demonstrate opportunities to reduce the regressivity of solar adoption, increase policy cost-effectiveness, and improve welfare for low-wealth households. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 个人在一系列经济行为中都会在当下消费与未来消费之间进行权衡，而这种权衡可能因社会经济群体而异。为评估这些权衡，我们利用加利福尼亚州家庭层面关于太阳辐照度、用电量和电价的数据，估计了住宅太阳能采用和系统规模的动态模型。这些数据提供了相对于前期成本、采用太阳能未来收益的、具有合理外生性的变异。我们发现，低、中、高财富家庭的隐含贴现率分别为15.3%、13.8%和10.0%。反事实模拟表明，存在降低太阳能采用累退性、提高政策成本效益以及改善低财富家庭福利的机会。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: A Dynamic Model of Vehicle Ownership, Type Choice, and Usage
Equilibrium Effects of Competition on Solar Photovoltaic Demand and Pricing
Learning-by-Doing in Solar Photovoltaic Installations
abstract: The solar photovoltaic industry has received billions of dollars of subsidies, motivated by environmental externalities and learning-by-doing spillovers across firms. This study investigates cost reductions due to localized learning using data on all rooftop solar installations in California from 2002 to 2012. We develop a dynamic model of solar demand and supply that addresses changing market power and dynamic pricing incentives that may mask learning. We find that learning is localized (within-county), much of it is appropriable, and  it reduces non-hardware costs by an average of 12 cents per Watt over the range of our data. The consumer surplus and environmental benefits from the California incentives still exceed the costs of the program.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏产业已获得数十亿美元的补贴，其动机在于环境外部性以及企业之间的干中学溢出效应。本研究利用2002年至2012年加利福尼亚州所有屋顶太阳能安装的数据，考察了因本地化学习而带来的成本下降。我们构建了一个太阳能需求与供给的动态模型，该模型处理了可能掩盖学习效应的市场势力变化和动态定价激励。我们发现，学习具有本地化特征（在县内发生），其中大部分可被占有，并且在我们数据的时间范围内，它使非硬件成本平均每瓦降低12美分。加利福尼亚州激励政策所带来的消费者剩余和环境效益，仍然超过该项目的成本。

title: Self- and Social Signaling: Evidence from Solar Adoption
abstract: Prosocial behavior plays a role in many economic contexts, and it has been explained by altruism, social pressure, signaling, and expectations of fairness and reciprocity. We examine prosocial behavior in a context that allows us to distinguish the role of self-signaling and social signaling from alternative explanations, including warm glow. Our context is residential solar, and self-signaling is separately identified from social signaling by the exogenous visibility of potential solar arrays. We show that the political affiliation of proximate peers influences the extent of self-signaling and is crowded out by the private benefits of installing solar. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 亲社会行为在许多经济情境中都发挥作用，它可以由利他主义、社会压力、信号传递以及对公平与互惠的期望来解释。我们在一个能够将自我信号传递与社会信号传递的作用，同其他解释（包括“温情满足”）区分开来的情境中考察亲社会行为。我们的研究情境是住宅太阳能，而自我信号传递与社会信号传递之间的区分，是通过潜在太阳能板的外生可见性实现的。我们表明，邻近同伴的政治立场会影响自我信号传递的程度，并且会被安装太阳能所带来的私人收益所挤出。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: The Effect of Fuel Economy Standards on Vehicle Weight Dispersion and Accident Fatalities
abstract: The firm response to regulation is seldom as controversial as in the context of fuel economy standards, a dominant policy to reduce emissions from vehicles worldwide. It has long been argued that such standards lead to vehicle weight changes that increase accident fatalities. Using unconditional quantile regression, we are the first to document the effect of the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standards on the vehicle weight distribution. We find that on net CAFE reduced fatalities, with lowered mean weight dominating increased dispersion. When monetized, this effect suggests positive net benefits from CAFE even with no undervaluation of fuel economy.
abstract_zh: 在全球范围内，用于减少车辆排放的主要政策是燃油经济性标准，而企业对监管的反应很少像在该标准问题上这样存在争议。长期以来，人们一直认为此类标准会导致车辆重量发生变化，从而增加交通事故死亡人数。利用无条件分位数回归，我们首次记录了企业平均燃油经济性（CAFE）标准对车辆重量分布的影响。我们发现，从净效应来看，CAFE降低了死亡人数，其中平均重量下降的作用超过了离散程度上升的作用。若将这一效应货币化，即便不存在对燃油经济性的低估，它也表明CAFE带来了正的净收益。

title: The Musk Partisan Effect on Tesla Sales
Valuing Technology Complementarities: Rooftop Solar and Energy Storage
abstract: Product complementarities can shape market patterns, influencing the demand for related products and their accessories. This study examines complementarities in the demand for rooftop solar and an accessory, battery energy storage. Using nationwide administrative data, we estimate a dynamic nested-logit model of solar and storage adoption. We quantify the demand complementarity between solar and storage, and find that if storage was not available, 20% of households who can adopt solar and storage would not adopt anything. We find that the demand for solar and storage bundles increases with power outages, with a larger effect in California.
abstract_zh: 产品之间的互补性可以塑造市场格局，并影响对相关产品及其配件的需求。本研究考察了屋顶太阳能与其配件——电池储能——之间需求的互补性。利用全国范围的行政数据，我们估计了太阳能与储能采用的动态嵌套logit模型。我们量化了太阳能与储能之间的需求互补性，发现如果没有储能可供选择，能够采用太阳能和储能的家庭中有20%将不会采用任何一种。我们还发现，太阳能与储能组合的需求会随着停电次数的增加而上升，而且在加利福尼亚州这一效应更大。

title: Air Pollution and Solar Energy: Evidence from Wildfires
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental & Resource Economists
abstract: There is strong evidence on the mortality and morbidity external costs of air pollution. This paper focuses on another source of air pollution externality: the loss in solar electricity generation from increased atmospheric opacity due to air pollution. We use data from residential rooftop solar panels and exploit quasi-random variation in air opacity from wildfire smoke and wind conditions to estimate that PM2.5 pollution reduced annual solar generation in California by over 450GWh, or 4% of total potential generation. This is equivalent to an annual externality of $177 per ton of PM2.5 emitted. Our findings suggest that there is a positive feedback from decarbonisation policies, where reduced dependence on fossil fuels improves air quality, leading to an even greater productivity of solar generation, further reducing emissions.
abstract_zh: 关于空气污染的死亡率和发病率外部成本，已有大量有力证据。本文关注空气污染外部性的另一个来源：空气污染导致大气不透明度上升，从而造成太阳能发电量损失。我们利用住宅屋顶太阳能板的数据，并利用野火烟雾和风况所引起的大气不透明度的准随机变异，估计出PM2.5污染使加利福尼亚州每年的太阳能发电量减少了超过450吉瓦时，相当于潜在总发电量的4%。这相当于每排放一吨PM2.5，每年产生177美元的外部成本。我们的发现表明，脱碳政策存在一种正向反馈：减少对化石燃料的依赖改善了空气质量，从而使太阳能发电的生产率进一步提高，并进一步减少排放。

title: Boundary Effects in the Diffusion of New Products on Cartesian Networks
Carbon Policy and the Emissions Implications of Electric Vehicles
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental & Resource Economists
abstract: Will a carbon tax improve the welfare consequences of policies to promote electric vehicles? This paper examines when a complementarity could exist between carbon pricing and high electric vehicle adoption. We analyze electricity generation in recent years to show that in several regions, carbon pricing interacts with electric vehicle adoption. Under moderate carbon prices like those in effect today, additional electric vehicles will be more likely to be charged with coalfired generation than without carbon pricing. We confirm this finding using a detailed dynamic model that includes the transportation and power sectors. At much higher carbon prices, the effect reverses.
abstract_zh: 碳税能否改善促进电动汽车政策的福利后果？本文考察了碳定价与电动汽车的高普及率之间何时可能存在互补关系。我们分析了近年来的电力生产情况，表明在若干地区，碳定价与电动汽车的普及存在相互作用。在当前实行的适度碳价水平下，与没有碳定价的情形相比，新增的电动汽车更有可能以燃煤发电进行充电。我们利用一个包含交通与电力部门的详细动态模型证实了这一发现。而当碳价高得多时，该效应则会逆转。

title: Climate Change Through the Lens of Macroeconomic Modeling
abstract: There is a rapidly advancing literature on the macroeconomics of climate change. This review focuses on developments in the construction and solution of structural integrated assessment models (IAMs), highlighting the marriage of state-of-the-art natural science with general equilibrium theory. We discuss challenges in solving dynamic stochastic IAMs with sharp nonlinearities, multiple regions, and multiple sources of risk. Key innovations in deep learning and other machine learning approaches overcome many computational challenges and enhance the accuracy and relevance of policy findings. We conclude with an overview of recent applications of IAMs and key policy insights.
abstract_zh: 关于气候变化宏观经济学的文献正在迅速发展。本综述聚焦于结构综合评估模型（IAM）的构建与求解方面的进展，强调了前沿自然科学与一般均衡理论的结合。我们讨论了在求解具有剧烈非线性、多地区以及多种风险来源的动态随机IAM时所面临的挑战。深度学习及其他机器学习方法的关键创新克服了许多计算难题，并提高了政策研究结论的准确性与相关性。最后，我们概述了IAM的近期应用以及主要的政策洞见。

title: Human Health Impacts of Energy Transitions across the United States among Sociodemographic Subpopulations for the Year 2050
abstract: Strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions may provide health benefits through improved air quality, yet these benefits might not be equitably distributed. Understanding these cobenefits and who receives them can aid policymakers in prioritizing mitigation strategies. We investigated four future energy scenarios (port electrification, electric vehicles, natural gas, energy efficiency) and a business-as-usual scenario to determine how changes to ambient fine particle (PM 2.5 ) levels impact health within the contiguous United States (U.S.) by region, race/ethnicity, urbanicity, and income. We also investigated how methodological assumptions affect findings. Our projections of avoided mortalities from energy transition policies range from 67,011 (95% CI: 45,692, 82,397) to 81,003 (55,286, 99,532) in 2050. The monetized health benefits from avoided mortalities and hospitalizations range from $785.8 billion to $949.9 billion/year. These benefits vary by region and subpopulation, with Black, suburban, and less wealthy Americans experiencing higher percent avoided mortality across scenarios. Results were sensitive to assumptions for future concentration–response functions relating pollution levels to health, baseline incidence rates, and population projections. Our findings indicate energy policies transitioning from fossil fuel production in the U.S. provide substantial health and economic benefits that vary across populations and help reduce environmental health inequities in exposure and associated morality.
abstract_zh: 减少温室气体排放的策略可能通过改善空气质量带来健康效益，但这些效益的分配未必公平。理解这些协同效益以及谁能从中获益，有助于决策者确定缓解策略的优先顺序。我们考察了四种未来能源情景（港口电气化、电动汽车、天然气、能源效率）以及一项照常情景，以确定环境细颗粒物（PM 2.5）水平的变化如何按地区、种族/族裔、城市化程度和收入影响美国本土（contiguous United States）的健康。我们还考察了方法论假设如何影响研究结论。我们对能源转型政策在2050年避免死亡人数的预测范围为67,011例（95%置信区间：45,692至82,397）至81,003例（55,286至99,532）。避免死亡和住院所带来的货币化健康效益为每年7,858亿美元至9,499亿美元。这些效益因地区和亚群体而异，在各情景下，黑人、郊区居民以及较不富裕的美国人避免死亡的百分比更高。研究结果对与污染水平和健康相关的未来浓度-反应函数、基线发病率以及人口预测的假设较为敏感。我们的研究结果表明，美国从化石燃料生产转向其他能源的能源政策，带来了可观的健康和经济效益，这些效益在不同人群之间存在差异，并有助于减少暴露及相关死亡率方面的环境健康不平等。

title: Microeconomics of the Solar Rebound Under Net Metering
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental & Resource Economists
abstract: Residential solar photovoltaics generate “green” electricity but may also lead to an increase in household electricity consumption—a phenomenon termed the “solar rebound effect.” This study develops a theoretical framework for understanding the solar rebound. We show that the solar rebound is inherently linked to the net-metering compensation a household faces. While the solar rebound is often simply a pure income effect, it can also include a substitution effect in some policy contexts. A negative solar rebound is even possible. We derive the welfare effects of the solar rebound and provide insights for econometric estimation.
abstract_zh: 住宅太阳能光伏发电产生“绿色”电力，但也可能导致家庭用电量增加——这一现象被称为“太阳能反弹效应”。本研究构建了一个理论框架，用以理解太阳能反弹效应。我们表明，太阳能反弹效应与家庭所面临的净计量补偿内在相关。太阳能反弹效应往往仅仅是纯粹的收入效应，但在某些政策背景下，它也可能包含替代效应。甚至可能出现负的太阳能反弹效应。我们推导了太阳能反弹效应的福利效应，并为计量经济估计提供了相应见解。

title: New Frontiers in Research on Industrial Decarbonization
Optimizing Electric Vehicle Infrastructure
abstract: What are the welfare gains from upgrading electric vehicle infrastructure? This paper develops a model of electric vehicle charging location decisions incorporating the transportation network structure, allocation of travel, and the effect on electric vehicle demand. We estimate the model with rich data on vehicle registrations, road segments, cell phone tracks, and charging locations and characteristics. We examine a counterfactual that adds level 3 (direct current fast) chargers optimally in the Connecticut transportation network. We find that adding chargers yields significant time savings and consumer welfare gains, while electric vehicle market shares are only modestly affected.
abstract_zh: 升级电动汽车基础设施能带来多大的福利收益？本文构建了一个电动汽车充电地点决策模型，纳入了交通网络结构、出行分配以及对电动汽车需求的影响。我们利用丰富的数据对模型进行估计，包括车辆登记、路段、手机轨迹以及充电站位置和特征。我们考察了一项反事实情形：在康涅狄格州的交通网络中，以最优方式增设三级（直流快充）充电桩。我们发现，增设充电桩能显著节省出行时间并带来消费者福利收益，而电动汽车市场份额仅受到适度影响。

title: Public Transport Pricing: An Evaluation of the 9-Euro Ticket and an Alternative Policy Proposal
Reforming Regulatory and Spending Analysis: Introduction to a Symposium on Revising Benefit-Cost Guidance
The Health Impacts of Transitioning Away from Fossil Fuel Toward Cleaner Energy
abstract: While energy transitions have always taken place, shifts have historically been primarily from one type of fossil fuel to another (e.g., from coal to oil). Yet today we are experiencing transitions away from fossil fuel toward cleaner and sustainable energy sources. These transitions include shifts to renewable energy, electric vehicles, pedestrian pathways and more walkable cities, energy efficiency measures in the built environment, and increased public transportation. This restructuring of our energy system will bring impacts on public health (e.g., improved air quality from lower use of traditional gasoline-powered vehicles). Furthermore, the transition can lower emissions of greenhouse gases (GHGs), thereby helping slow climate change and minimize its anticipated impacts on public health. While more work is needed to understand the full implications of these energy transitions, including the implications for environmental justice in terms of who will share in the health benefits and potential detriments such as increased emissions from brake wear for electric vehicles, the existing literature indicates substantial benefits to public health. Moving away from fossil fuel may offer a rare win-win strategy for a healthier society with a cleaner environment and lower GHGs.
abstract_zh: 尽管能源转型一直都在发生，但历史上的转变主要是在不同类型的化石燃料之间进行的（例如从煤炭转向石油）。然而，如今我们正经历从化石燃料转向更清洁、可持续能源的转型。这些转型包括转向可再生能源、电动汽车、步行路径和更适宜步行的城市、建成环境中的能效措施，以及公共交通的增加。我们能源系统的这种重构将对公众健康产生影响（例如，传统汽油动力汽车使用减少，空气质量随之改善）。此外，这一转型能够降低温室气体（GHG）排放，从而有助于减缓气候变化，并将其对公众健康的预期影响降到最低。尽管还需要开展更多工作，以理解这些能源转型的全部影响，包括它们对环境正义的影响（即谁将分享健康效益，以及电动汽车刹车磨损排放增加等潜在损害），但现有文献表明，其对公众健康的益处十分可观。摆脱化石燃料或许能为实现更健康的社会、更清洁的环境和更低的温室气体排放，提供一种难得的双赢战略。

title: How Is Rooftop Solar Capitalized in Home Prices?
Peer-to-Peer Solar and Social Rewards: Evidence From a Field Experiment
abstract: Observability has been demonstrated to influence the adoption of pro-social behavior in a variety of contexts. This study implements a field experiment to examine the influence of observability in the context of a novel pro-social behavior: peer-to-peer solar. Peer-to-peer solar offers an opportunity to households who cannot have solar on their homes to access solar energy from their neighbors. However, unlike solar installations, peer-to-peer solar is an invisible form of pro-environmental behavior. We implemented a set of randomized campaigns using Facebook ads in the Massachusetts cities of Cambridge and Somerville, in partnership with a peer-to-peer company. In the campaigns, treated customers were informed that they could share “green reports” online, providing information to others about their greenness. We find that interest in peer-to-peer solar increases by up to 30% when “green reports,” which would make otherwise invisible behavior visible, are mentioned in the ads.
abstract_zh: 在多种情境中，可观察性已被证明会影响亲社会行为的采用。本研究开展了一项现场实验，以考察可观察性在一种新型亲社会行为——点对点太阳能（peer-to-peer solar）——中的影响。点对点太阳能为无法在自家安装太阳能的家庭提供了从邻居处获取太阳能的机会。然而，与太阳能装置不同，点对点太阳能是一种不可见的亲环境行为。我们与一家点对点太阳能公司合作，在马萨诸塞州的剑桥市和萨默维尔市，通过Facebook广告实施了一系列随机化推广活动。在这些活动中，实验组客户被告知，他们可以在线分享“绿色报告”，向他人提供有关其环保表现的信息。我们发现，当广告中提及“绿色报告”（它能使原本不可见的行为变得可见）时，对点对点太阳能的兴趣最多可提高30%。

Has Consumer Acceptance of Electric Vehicles Been Increasing? Evidence from Microdata on Every New Vehicle Sale in the United States
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) sales have been rapidly growing around the world, spurred by technology advances and policy actions. This study leverages rich data on all individual new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States from 2014 to 2020. We examine how EV attributes, prices, and sales have evolved, exploring substantial heterogeneity across geography, vehicle class, price range, and demographics. We use a matching analysis to compare EVs to similar conventional vehicles to find that EVs have been surprisingly competitive in very recent years. This suggests that constrained supply is an important determinant of the low overall EV market share.
abstract_zh: 在技术进步和政策行动的推动下，全球电动汽车（EV）销量迅速增长。本研究利用了2014年至2020年间在美国售出的所有个体新型轻型车辆的丰富数据。我们考察了电动汽车的属性、价格和销量是如何演变的，并探讨了其在地理、车辆类别、价格区间和人口特征方面存在的显著异质性。我们采用匹配分析，将电动汽车与相似的传统燃油车进行比较，发现电动汽车在最近几年竞争力出人意料地强。这表明，供给受限是电动汽车整体市场份额较低的一个重要决定因素。

title: U.S. Benefit-Cost Analysis Requires Revision
Conformity and Conservation: Evidence from Home Landscaping and Water Conservation
abstract: How do consumers value conformity, and what are the implications for conservation policy? In this article, we study conformity in homeowners’ landscaping choices—which have important consequences for water consumption—for housing parcels throughout a large arid American city. We use machine learning techniques to generate precise land cover classifications on each parcel from remote sensing imagery, allowing us to obtain hedonic estimates of the marginal value of conformity. Our work is unique as the first to study this behavioral phenomenon using rich observational data from a real‐world market. We then overlay these estimates on a theoretical model to characterize how conformity motives interact with conservation. We find that Pigouvian pricing is roughly half as effective in the presence of conformity, as our estimated conformity effects will countervail price effects. This work shows how behavioral phenomena, such as conformity, may have empirically relevant impacts on the effectiveness of standard conservation interventions.
abstract_zh: 消费者如何看待从众？这对节水政策有何启示？在本文中，我们研究了房主在景观美化选择中的从众行为——这些选择对用水量具有重要影响——研究对象为美国一座大型干旱城市中各住宅地块。我们利用机器学习技术，从遥感影像中为每个地块生成精确的土地覆盖分类，从而得以估计从众的边际价值的特征价格（hedonic）。我们的工作独具特色，是首次利用真实市场中丰富的观测数据研究这一行为现象。随后，我们将这些估计结果纳入一个理论模型，以刻画从众动机如何与保护政策相互作用。我们发现，在存在从众效应的情况下，庇古定价的有效性约为原来的一半，因为我们估计出的从众效应将抵消价格效应。这项工作表明，从众等行为现象可能对标准保护干预措施的有效性产生具有实证意义的影响。

title: Equilibrium Trade in Automobile Markets
Visibility and Peer Influence in Durable Good Adoption
Consumer Myopia in Vehicle Purchases: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
abstract: A central question in the analysis of fuel economy policy is whether consumers are myopic with regards to future fuel costs. We provide the first evidence on the consumer valuation of fuel economy from a natural experiment that provides exogenous variation in fuel economy ratings. We examine the short-run equilibrium effects of a restatement of fuel economy ratings that affected 1.6 million vehicles. Using the implied changes in willingness to pay, we find that consumers act myopically: consumers are indifferent between $1.00 in discounted fuel costs and $0. 16–0.39 in the purchase price when discounting at 4 percent. This undervaluation persists under a wide range of assumptions. (JEL D12, L62, L71, L11)
abstract_zh: 燃油经济性政策分析中的一个核心问题是，消费者对未来燃油成本是否短视。我们利用一个提供燃油经济性评级外生变异的自然实验，首次给出了消费者对燃油经济性估值的证据。我们考察了一次燃油经济性评级重新公布事件的短期均衡效应，该事件影响了160万辆车。利用隐含的支付意愿变化，我们发现消费者表现出短视行为：当贴现率为4%时，消费者认为折现后1.00美元的燃油成本与0.16至0.39美元的购车价格无差异。这种低估在广泛的假设条件下依然存在。（JEL D12, L62, L71, L11）

title: Designing Fuel-Economy Standards in Light of Electric Vehicles
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Electric vehicles are declining in cost so rapidly that they may claim a large share of the vehicle market by 2030. This paper examines a set of practical regulatory design considerations for fuel-economy standards or greenhouse gas standards in the context of highly uncertain electric vehicle costs in the next decade. The analysis takes a cost-effectiveness approach and uses analytical modeling and simulation to develop insight. I show that counting electric vehicles under a standard with a multiplier or assuming zero upstream emissions can reduce electric vehicle market share by weakening the standards. Furthermore, there are trade-offs from implementing a backstop conventional vehicle standard along with a second standard that also includes electric vehicles, but such a backstop offers the possibility of ensuring that low-cost conventional vehicle technologies are exploited.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车成本下降得如此之快，以至于到2030年它们可能占据车辆市场的很大份额。本文在未来十年电动汽车成本高度不确定的背景下，考察了燃油经济性标准或温室气体标准在监管设计上的一系列实际考虑。本分析采用成本有效性方法，并运用解析建模与模拟来形成见解。我证明，在某一标准中以乘数方式计入电动汽车，或假定其上游排放为零，会通过削弱标准而降低电动汽车的市场份额。此外，在实施一项以传统汽车为兜底（backstop）的标准，并同时实施另一项也包括电动汽车的标准时，存在一些权衡；不过，这样的兜底标准有可能确保低成本的传统汽车技术得到充分利用。

title: Induced Innovation in Energy Technologies and Systems: A Review of Evidence and Potential Implications for CO2 Mitigation
Linking Housing Policy, Housing Typology and Residential Energy Demand in the United States
abstract: Residential energy demand can be greatly influenced by the types of housing structures that households live in, but few studies have assessed changes in the composition of housing stocks as a strategy for reducing residential energy demand or greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. In this paper we examine the effects of three sequenced federal policies on the share of new housing construction by type in the U.S., and estimate the cumulative influence of those policies on the composition of the 2015 housing stock. In a counterfactual 2015 housing stock without the policy effects, 14 million housing units exist as multifamily rather than single-family, equal to 14.1% of urban housing. Accompanied by floor area reductions of 0-50%, the switch from single- to multifamily housing reduces energy demand by 27-47% per household, and total urban residential energy by 4.6-8.3%. This paper is the first to link federal policies to housing outcomes by type and estimate associated effects on residential energy and GHG emissions. Removing policy barriers and disincentives to multifamily housing can unlock a large potential for reducing residential energy demand and GHG emissions in the coming decades.
abstract_zh: 住户所居住的住房结构类型会极大地影响住宅能源需求，但很少有研究将住房存量构成的变化作为减少住宅能源需求或温室气体（GHG）排放的策略来加以评估。本文考察了三项相继实施的联邦政策对美国新建住房按类型划分的份额的影响，并估计了这些政策对2015年住房存量构成的累积影响。在一个不存在政策效应的反事实2015年住房存量中，有1,400万套住房为多户住宅而非独栋住宅，占城市住房的14.1%。伴随着0至50%的居住面积减少，由独栋住宅转向多户住宅使每户家庭的能源需求降低27%至47%，并使城市住宅能源总量降低4.6%至8.3%。本文首次将联邦政策与按类型划分的住房结果联系起来，并估计了其对住宅能源和温室气体排放的相关影响。消除对多户住宅的政策障碍和负激励，可以在未来几十年释放出降低住宅能源需求和温室气体排放的巨大潜力。

title: Pricing of Indirect Emissions Accelerates Low-Carbon Transition of U.S. Light Vehicle Sector
abstract: Large-scale electric vehicle adoption can greatly reduce emissions from vehicle tailpipes. However, analysts have cautioned that it can come with increased indirect emissions from electricity and battery production that are not commonly regulated by transport policies. We combine integrated energy modeling and life cycle assessment to compare optimal policy scenarios that price emissions at the tailpipe only, versus both tailpipe and indirect emissions. Surprisingly, scenarios that also price indirect emissions exhibit higher, rather than reduced, sales of electric vehicles, while yielding lower cumulative tailpipe and indirect emissions. Expected technological change ensures that emissions from electricity and battery production are more than offset by reduced emissions of gasoline production. Given continued decarbonization of electricity supply, results show that a large-scale adoption of electric vehicles is able to reduce CO2 emissions through more channels than previously expected. Further, carbon pricing of stationary sources will also favor electric vehicles.
abstract_zh: 大规模采用电动汽车可以大幅减少汽车尾气排放。然而，分析人士警告，这可能伴随着来自电力和电池生产的间接排放增加，而这些排放通常不受交通政策的监管。我们结合综合能源建模与生命周期评估，比较了仅对尾气排放定价与同时对尾气和间接排放定价的最优政策情景。令人意外的是，同时对间接排放定价的情景显示出电动汽车销量更高而非更低，同时累计尾气及间接排放更低。预期的技术进步确保，电力和电池生产产生的排放，能够被汽油生产减排所超额抵消。在电力供应持续脱碳的前提下，结果表明，大规模采用电动汽车能够通过比此前预期更多的渠道减少二氧化碳排放。此外，对固定排放源征收碳价也将有利于电动汽车。

title: Social Learning and Solar Photovoltaic Adoption: Evidence from a Field Experiment
abstract:
Growing literature points to the effectiveness of leveraging social interactions and nudges to spur adoption of prosocial behaviors. This study investigates a large-scale behavioral intervention designed to actively leverage social learning and peer interactions to encourage adoption of residential solar photovoltaic systems. Municipalities choose a solar installer offering group pricing and undertake an informational campaign driven by volunteer ambassadors. We find a causal treatment effect of 37 installations per municipality from the campaigns and no evidence of harvesting or persistence. The intervention also lowers installation prices. Randomized controlled trials based on the intervention show that selection into the program is important, whereas group pricing is not. Our results suggest that the program provided economies of scale and lowered consumer acquisition costs, leading to low-cost emission reductions.
This paper was accepted by Matthew Shum, marketing.
abstract_zh:
越来越多的文献指出，利用社会互动和助推（nudge）来促进亲社会行为的采用是有效的。本研究考察了一项大规模行为干预，该干预旨在积极利用社会学习和同伴互动，以鼓励住宅太阳能光伏系统的采用。各市政府选择一家提供团购价格的太阳能安装商，并由志愿者大使推动开展信息宣传活动。我们发现，这些活动使每个市政府的安装数量因果性地增加了37套，并且没有证据表明存在“收割”效应或效果持续性下降。该干预还降低了安装价格。基于该干预开展的随机对照试验表明，参与项目的自选择十分重要，而团购价格则不然。我们的结果表明，该项目实现了规模经济，并降低了消费者获取成本，从而带来了低成本的减排。
本文由营销学教授马修·舒姆（Matthew Shum）接收。

Peer Effects in Residential Water Conservation: Evidence from Migration
abstract: Social interactions are widely understood to influence consumer decisions in many choice settings. This paper identifies causal peer effects in residential water conservation during the summer using variation from movers. We classify high-resolution remote sensing images to provide evidence that conversions of green landscaping to dry landscaping are a primary determinant of the reductions in water consumption. We also find suggestive evidence that without a price signal, peer effects are muted, indicating a possible complementarity between information and prices. These results inform water use policy in many areas of the world threatened by recurring drought conditions. (JEL D12, L95, Q25, Q54, Z13)
abstract_zh: 社会互动被广泛认为在许多选择情境中都会影响消费者决策。本文利用迁移者带来的变异，识别了夏季住宅节水中的因果同伴效应。我们对高分辨率遥感影像进行分类，提供证据表明，将绿色景观改造为旱生景观，是用水量减少的主要决定因素。我们还发现了暗示性证据，表明在没有价格信号的情况下，同伴效应会减弱，这暗示信息与价格之间可能存在互补性。这些结果可为世界上许多受反复干旱威胁地区的用水政策提供参考。（JEL D12, L95, Q25, Q54, Z13）

A Tale of Two Tails: Commuting and the Fuel Price Response in Driving
abstract: Pricing greenhouse gases is widely understood as the most efficient approach for mitigating climate change, yet distributional effects hamper political acceptance. These distributional effects are especially important in transport, the fastest growing sector for greenhouse gas emissions. Using rich data covering the entire population of vehicles and households in Denmark, this study uncovers an important feature of driving demand: two groups of much more responsive households in the lower and upper tails of the work distance distribution. We further estimate the causal effect of public transport–a critical determinant of the upper tail–and show how public transport access can both reconcile differences in fuel price elasticities between the United States and Europe, and considerably influence the distributional effects of fuel pricing.
abstract_zh: 为温室气体定价被广泛认为是减缓气候变化最有效率的途径，但其分配效应阻碍了政治上的接受。在温室气体排放增长最快的部门——交通运输部门中，这些分配效应尤为重要。本研究利用涵盖丹麦全部车辆和家庭人口的丰富数据，揭示了驾驶需求的一个重要特征：在通勤距离分布的下尾和上尾，各有一组对燃油价格反应明显更强的家庭。我们进一步估计了公共交通（上尾的一个关键决定因素）的因果效应，并说明公共交通的可达性如何既能调和美国与欧洲在燃油价格弹性上的差异，又能显著影响燃油定价的分配效应。

title: Fostering Energy Innovation for a Sustainable Twenty-First Century
Hurdles and Steps: Estimating Demand for Solar Photovoltaics
abstract: This paper estimates demand for residential solar photovoltaic (PV) systems using a new approach to address three empirical challenges that often arise with count data: excess zeros, unobserved heterogeneity, and endogeneity of price. Our results imply a price elasticity of demand for solar PV systems of -0 65.Counterfactual policy simulations indicate that reducing state financial incentives in half would have led to 9% fewer new installations in Connecticut in 2014.Calculations suggest a subsidy program cost of $364/tCO 2 assuming solar displaces natural gas. Our Poisson hurdle approach holds promise for modeling the demand for many new technologies.
abstract_zh: 本文采用一种新方法估计住宅太阳能光伏（PV）系统的需求，以应对计数数据中经常出现的三个实证挑战：过多的零值、不可观测的异质性以及价格的内生性。我们的结果意味着太阳能光伏系统的需求价格弹性为-0.65。反事实政策模拟表明，若将州政府财政激励减半，2014年康涅狄格州的新增装机量将减少9%。计算表明，假设太阳能取代天然气，补贴计划的成本为每吨CO2 364美元。我们的泊松跨栏（Poisson hurdle）方法有望用于对许多新技术的需求进行建模。

title: Is Abundant Natural Gas a Bridge to a Low-carbon Future or a Dead-end?
abstract: A fierce debate rages on whether abundant natural gas is a bridge to a low-carbon future or a hindrance to long-term decarbonization. This paper uses a detailed energy-economic market equilibrium model to study the effects of an upper bound case of natural gas availability. We show that a market-driven abundant natural gas supply can provide substantial reductions in air pollution but does not considerably reduce CO2 emissions in the longer-term, especially relative to a moderate carbon price. However, we quantify large welfare benefits from abundant natural gas. The spatial disaggregation of our results allows for a clear picture of the distributional impacts of abundant natural gas under different carbon price scenarios, illustrating welfare gains by most regions regardless of whether there is carbon pricing, but substantial heterogeneity in the welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 关于丰富的天然气究竟是通往低碳未来的桥梁，还是阻碍长期脱碳的障碍，存在激烈的争论。本文利用一个详细的能源经济市场均衡模型，研究天然气供应上限情景的影响。我们表明，市场驱动的充足天然气供应能够大幅减少空气污染，但在较长期内并不能显著减少CO2排放，尤其是与适度的碳价相比。然而，我们量化了充足天然气供应所带来的巨大福利收益。我们结果的空间细分，使我们能够清晰地描绘出在不同碳价情景下，充足天然气供应的分配影响，表明无论是否实行碳定价，大多数地区都能获得福利收益，但福利收益的异质性很大。

title: Advances in Evaluating Energy Efficiency Policies and Programs
abstract: This paper reviews the recent evidence on the effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of energy efficiency interventions. After a brief review of explanations for the energy efficiency gap, we explore key issues in energy efficiency evaluation, including the use of randomized controlled trials and incentives faced by those performing evaluations. We provide a summary table of energy savings results by type of efficiency intervention. We also develop an updated aggregate estimate of 2.8 cents per kilowatt hour (kWh) of net savings from utility energy efficiency programs but note that this estimate is based on aggregate utility-reported energy savings. Our review of the economics literature suggests that energy savings are often smaller than implied by utility-reported results, but some interventions appear to be cost-effective relative to the marginal cost of electricity supply.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了近期关于能效干预措施有效性和成本效益的证据。在简要综述了能效差距的各种解释之后，我们探讨了能效评估中的关键问题，包括随机对照试验的使用，以及从事评估者所面临的激励。我们提供了一张按能效干预类型划分的节能成果汇总表。我们还对公用事业能效项目的净节约量进行了更新的总体估计，为每千瓦时（kWh）2.8美分，但需要指出，该估计基于公用事业报告的总体节能量。我们对经济学文献的回顾表明，节能量往往小于公用事业报告结果所暗示的水平，但相对于电力供应的边际成本而言，某些干预措施似乎具有成本效益。

title: Nudging Energy Efficiency Audits: Evidence from a Field Experiment
The Cost of Reducing Greenhouse Gas Emissions
abstract: Most countries, including the United States, have an array of greenhouse gas mitigation policies, which provide subsidies or restrictions typically aimed at specific technologies or sectors. Such climate policies range from automobile fuel economy standards, to gasoline taxes, to mandating that a certain amount of electricity in a state comes from renewables, to subsidizing solar and wind electrical generation, to mandates requiring the blending of biofuels into the surface transportation fuel supply, to supply-side restrictions on fossil fuel extraction. This paper reviews the costs of various technologies and actions aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Our aim is twofold. First, we seek to provide an up-to-date summary of costs of actions that can be taken now using currently available technology. These costs focus on expenditures and emissions reductions over the life of a project compared to some business-as-usual benchmark—for example, replacing coal-fired electricity generation with wind, or weatherizing a home. We refer to these costs as static because they are costs over the life of a specific project undertaken now, and they ignore spillovers. Our second aim is to distinguish between dynamic and static costs and to argue that some actions taken today with seemingly high static costs can have low dynamic costs, and vice versa. We make this argument at a general level and through two case studies, of solar panels and of electric vehicles, technologies whose costs have fallen sharply. Under the right circumstances, dynamic effects will offer a justification for policies that have high costs according to a myopic calculation.
abstract_zh: 包括美国在内的大多数国家都实施了一系列温室气体减排政策，这些政策通常针对特定技术或部门提供补贴或限制。此类气候政策的范围从汽车燃油经济性标准，到汽油税，再到规定某州一定比例的电力必须来自可再生能源，到对太阳能和风力发电进行补贴，到要求在地面交通燃料供应中掺混生物燃料的强制性规定，再到对化石燃料开采的供给侧限制。本文回顾了旨在减少温室气体排放的各种技术和行动的成本。我们的目标有两个。第一，我们力图对目前可利用现有技术采取的行动的成本进行最新的总结。这些成本关注相对于某种照常情景（business-as-usual）基准，在项目全生命周期内的支出与减排量，例如用风电取代燃煤发电，或对住宅进行节能改造。我们将这些成本称为静态成本，因为它们是当前所开展的特定项目在其全生命周期内的成本，并且忽略了溢出效应。第二，我们旨在区分动态成本与静态成本，并论证如下观点：当前一些看似静态成本很高的行动，其动态成本可能很低，反之亦然。我们在一般层面并通过两个案例研究（太阳能电池板和电动汽车，这两种技术的成本均已大幅下降）论证了这一观点。在恰当的条件下，动态效应将为那些按短视计算成本较高的政策提供正当理由。

title: Characteristics of Low-Priced Solar Systems in the U.S.
abstract: Despite impressive recent cost reductions, there is wide dispersion in the prices of installed solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. We identify the most important factors that make a system likely to be low priced (LP). Our sample consists of detailed characteristics for 42,611 small-scale (< 15 kW) PV systems installed in 15 U.S. states during 2013. Using four definitions of LP systems, we compare LP and non-LP systems and find statistically significant differences in nearly all factors explored, including competition, installer scale, markets, demographics, ownership, policy, and system components. Logit and probit model results robustly indicate that LP systems are associated with markets with few active installers; experienced installers; customer ownership; large systems; retrofits; and thin-film, low-efficiency, and Chinese modules. We also find significant differences across states, with LP systems much more likely to occur in some than in others. Our focus on the left tail of the price distribution provides implications for policy that are distinct from recent studies of mean prices. While those studies find that PV subsidies increase mean prices, we find that subsidies also generate LP systems. PV subsidies appear to simultaneously shift and broaden the price distribution. Much of this broadening occurs in a particular location, northern California, which is worthy of further investigation with new data.
abstract_zh: 尽管近期成本大幅下降，已安装的太阳能光伏（PV）系统价格仍存在较大离散。我们识别出使一套系统更可能属于低价（LP）系统的最重要因素。我们的样本包括2013年在美国15个州安装的42,611套小型（<15 kW）光伏系统的详细特征。使用四种低价系统的定义，我们比较了低价系统与非低价系统，发现几乎所有考察因素上都存在统计上显著的差异，包括竞争程度、安装商规模、市场、人口特征、所有权、政策以及系统组件。Logit和Probit模型的结果稳健地表明，低价系统与活跃安装商较少的市场、经验丰富的安装商、客户自有、大型系统、改造项目，以及薄膜型、低效率和中国产组件相关。我们还发现各州之间存在显著差异，低价系统在某些州比在其他州更常见。我们聚焦于价格分布的左尾，由此得出的政策含义不同于近期关于平均价格的研究。那些研究发现光伏补贴会提高平均价格，而我们发现补贴同时也会催生低价系统。光伏补贴似乎同时使价格分布整体平移并使其扩散。这种扩散大部分发生在北加利福尼亚这一特定地区，值得利用新数据做进一步研究。

title: Lessons from First Campus Carbon Pricing Scheme
What Factors Affect the Prices of Low-Priced U.S. Solar PV Systems?
abstract: The price of solar PV systems has declined rapidly, yet there are some much lower-priced systems than others. This study explores the factors leading some systems to be so much lower priced than others. Using a data set of 42,611 residential-scale PV systems installed in the U.S. in 2013, we use quantile regressions to estimate the importance of factors affecting the installed prices for low-priced (LP) systems (those at the 10th percentile) in comparison to median-priced systems. We find that the value of solar to consumers–a variable that accounts for subsidies, electric rates, and PV generation levels–is associated with lower prices for LP systems but higher prices for median priced systems. Conversely, systems installed in new home construction are associated with lower prices at the median but higher prices for LP. Other variables have larger cost-reducing effects on LP than on median priced systems: systems installed in Arizona and Florida, as well as commercial and thin film systems. In contrast, the following have a smaller effect on prices for LP systems than median priced systems: tracking systems, self-installations, systems installed in Massachusetts, the system size, and installer experience. These results highlight the complex factors at play that lead to LP systems and shed light into how such LP systems can come about.
abstract_zh: 太阳能光伏系统的价格迅速下降，但不同系统之间的价格差异仍然很大，部分系统的价格远低于其他系统。本研究探讨了导致部分系统价格远低于其他系统的因素。利用2013年在美国安装的42,611套住宅规模光伏系统的数据集，我们运用分位数回归，估计影响低价（LP）系统（即处于第10百分位的系统）与中位价格系统相比的安装价格的各种因素的重要性。我们发现，太阳能对消费者的价值（一个综合了补贴、电价和光伏发电水平的变量）与低价系统的较低价格相关，但与中位价格系统的较高价格相关。相反，在新建住宅中安装的系统与中位价格时的较低价格相关，却与低价系统的较高价格相关。其他一些变量对低价系统的成本降低效应大于中位价格系统：安装在亚利桑那州和佛罗里达州的系统，以及商业用系统和薄膜系统。相比之下，以下因素对低价系统价格的影响小于中位价格系统：跟踪式系统、自行安装、安装在马萨诸塞州的系统、系统规模以及安装商的经验。这些结果凸显了导致低价系统出现的复杂因素，并揭示了此类低价系统如何能够形成。

title: Deconstructing Solar Photovoltaic Pricing: The Role of Market Structure, Technology, and Policy
abstract:
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system prices in the United States display considerable heterogeneity both across geographic locations and within a given location. Such heterogeneity may arise due to state and federal policies, differences in market structure, and other factors that influence demand and costs. This paper examines the relative importance of such factors on equilibrium solar PV system prices in the United States using a detailed dataset of roughly 100,000 recent residential and small commercial installations. As expected, we find that PV system prices differ based on characteristics of the systems. More interestingly, we find evidence suggesting that search costs and imperfect competition affect solar PV pricing.
Installer density substantially lowers prices, while regions with relatively generous financial incentives for solar PV are associated with higher prices.
abstract_zh:
美国太阳能光伏（PV）系统的价格，在不同地理位置之间以及同一地点内部都存在相当大的异质性。这种异质性可能源于州和联邦政策、市场结构差异以及其他影响需求和成本的因素。本文利用约10万套近期住宅和小型商业安装的详细数据集，考察了这些因素对美国太阳能光伏系统均衡价格的相对重要性。正如预期的那样，我们发现光伏系统价格因系统特征的不同而存在差异。更有趣的是，我们发现有证据表明，搜寻成本和不完全竞争会影响太阳能光伏定价。
安装商密度显著降低了价格，而太阳能光伏财政激励相对慷慨的地区则与较高的价格相关。

title: Opportunities for Advances in Climate Economics
Reforming the Federal Coal Leasing Program
The Rebound Effect and Energy Efficiency Policy
abstract: What do we know about the size of the rebound effect, the well-known phenomenon that improving energy efficiency may save less energy than expected due to a rebound of energy use? Is there any validity to the claims that energy efficiency improvements can actually lead to an increase in energy use (known as backfire)? This article clarifies what the rebound effect is and provides a guide for economists and policymakers interested in its existence and magnitude. We discuss how some studies in the literature consider a rebound effect that results from a costless exogenous increase in energy efficiency, whereas others examine the effects of a specific energy efficiency policy—a distinction that leads to very different welfare and policy implications. We present the most reliable evidence available about the size of the energy efficiency rebound effect and discuss situations where such estimation is extraordinarily difficult. With this in mind, we present a new way of thinking about the macroeconomic rebound effect. We conclude that overall, the existing research provides little support for the so-called backfire hypothesis. However, our understanding of the macroeconomic rebound effect remains limited, particularly as it relates to induced innovation and productivity growth. (JEL: H23, Q38, Q41)
abstract_zh: 关于反弹效应（即提高能源效率所节约的能源可能少于预期，原因在于能源使用量的反弹），我们究竟了解多少？其规模有多大？能源效率改进是否真的可能导致能源使用量增加（即所谓的“逆反”或backfire）？本文阐明了反弹效应的含义，并为关注其存在性和规模的经济学家与政策制定者提供指导。我们讨论了文献中的一些研究考察的是成本为零的外生能源效率提升所引起的反弹效应，而另一些研究考察的则是具体能效政策的效果——这一区别会导致截然不同的福利和政策含义。我们呈现了关于能效反弹效应规模的现有最可靠证据，并讨论了此类估计极为困难的情形。在此基础上，我们提出了一种思考宏观反弹效应的新方式。我们的结论是，总体而言，现有研究几乎不支持所谓的“逆反假说”。然而，我们对宏观反弹效应的理解仍然有限，特别是在其与诱致性创新和生产率增长的关系方面。（JEL: H23, Q38, Q41）

title: Heterogeneity in the Response to Gasoline Prices: Evidence from Pennsylvania and Implications for the Rebound Effect
Spatial Patterns of Solar Photovoltaic System Adoption: The Influence of Neighbors and the Built Environment
abstract: The diffusion of new technologies is often mediated by spatial and socioeconomic factors. This article empirically examines the diffusion of an important renewable energy technology: residential solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. Using detailed data on PV installations in Connecticut, we identify the spatial patterns of diffusion, which indicate considerable clustering of adoptions. This clustering does not simply follow the spatial distribution of income or population. We find that smaller centers contribute to adoption more than larger urban areas, in a wave-like centrifugal pattern. Our empirical estimation demonstrates a strong relationship between adoption and the number of nearby previously installed systems as well as built environment and policy variables. The effect of nearby systems diminishes with distance and time, suggesting a spatial neighbor effect conveyed through social interaction and visibility. These results disentangle the process of diffusion of PV systems and provide guidance to stakeholders in the solar market.
abstract_zh: 新技术的扩散往往受到空间和社会经济因素的调节。本文以实证方式考察了一项重要可再生能源技术——住宅太阳能光伏（PV）系统——的扩散。利用康涅狄格州光伏安装的详细数据，我们识别了扩散的空间格局，结果表明采用行为存在相当显著的集聚现象。这种集聚并非简单地遵循收入或人口的空间分布。我们发现，较小的城镇中心比大城市地区更能促进采用，呈现出一种波浪式的离心扩散格局。我们的实证估计表明，采用行为与附近已安装系统的数量，以及建成环境和政策变量之间存在密切关系。附近系统的影响随距离和时间的推移而减弱，这表明存在一种通过社会互动和可见性传递的空间邻里效应。这些结果厘清了光伏系统的扩散过程，并为太阳能市场的利益相关者提供了指导。

title: Bridging the Energy Efficiency Gap: Policy Insights from Economic Theory and Empirical Analysis
abstract: Despite several decades of government policies to promote energy efficiency, estimates of the costs and benefits of such policies remain controversial. At the heart of the controversy is whether there is an "energy efficiency gap," whereby consumers and firms fail to make seemingly positive net present value energy saving investments. High implicit discount rates, undervaluation of future fuel savings, and negative cost energy efficiency measures have all been discussed as evidence of the existence of a gap. We review explanations for an energy efficiency gap, including reasons why the size of the gap may be overstated, neoclassical explanations for a gap, and recent evidence from behavioral economics that has potential to help us understand why a gap could exist. Our review raises fundamental questions about traditional welfare analysis, yet we find the alternatives offered in the literature to be far from ready for use in policy analysis. Nevertheless, we offer several suggestions for policymakers and for future economic research.
abstract_zh: 尽管政府数十年来一直实施促进能效的政策，但对这些政策成本和收益的估计仍存在争议。争议的核心在于是否存在“能效差距”，即消费者和企业未能进行那些看似具有正的净现值的节能投资。高隐含贴现率、对未来燃油节约的低估，以及负成本的能效措施，都曾被作为能效差距存在的证据加以讨论。我们回顾了能效差距的各种解释，包括差距规模可能被夸大的原因、针对差距的新古典解释，以及行为经济学的最新证据，这些证据有助于我们理解差距为何可能存在。我们的综述提出了关于传统福利分析的根本性问题，但我们发现文献中提出的替代方法远未达到可用于政策分析的程度。尽管如此，我们仍为政策制定者和未来的经济学研究提出了若干建议。

title: Using and Improving the Social Cost of Carbon
abstract: The social cost of carbon (SCC) is a crucial tool for economic analysis of climate policies. The SCC estimates the dollar value of reduced climate change damages associated with a one-metric-ton reduction in carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. Although the conceptual basis, challenges, and merits of the SCC are well established, its use in government cost-benefit analysis (CBA) is relatively new. In light of challenges in constructing the SCC, its newness in government regulation, and the importance of updating, we propose an institutional process for regular SCC review and revision when used in government policy-making and suggest how scientists might contribute to improved SCC estimates.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳社会成本（SCC）是气候政策经济分析的关键工具。SCC 估算了每减少一公吨二氧化碳（CO2）排放所对应的气候变化损害减少量的美元价值。尽管 SCC 的概念基础、挑战和优点已得到充分确立，但其在政府成本效益分析（CBA）中的应用相对较新。鉴于构建 SCC 所面临的挑战、其在政府监管中的新近性以及持续更新的重要性，我们提出一套制度化流程，用于在政府政策制定中定期审查和修订 SCC，并探讨科学家如何为改进 SCC 估计作出贡献。

title: Barriers to Implementing Low Carbon Technologies
abstract: This paper reviews the major barriers to the adoption of low-carbon technologies, with a focus on market failures that provide a rationale for policy intervention to improve economic efficiency. Market failures include externalities, asymmetric information, institutional failures, regulatory failures, and failures of consumer or firm decision-making. We discuss central generation renewable energy technologies, CCS technology, distribution generation renewable energy, and technologies to reduce the demand for energy. For each technology category, we assess whether and how policy might improve economic efficiency, and point to key open research questions.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了低碳技术采用的主要障碍，重点关注为政策干预提供依据以提高经济效率的市场失灵。市场失灵包括外部性、信息不对称、制度失灵、监管失灵，以及消费者或企业决策失灵。我们讨论了集中式可再生能源发电技术、碳捕集与封存（CCS）技术、分布式可再生能源发电，以及减少能源需求的技术。对于每一类技术，我们评估政策是否以及如何能够提高经济效率，并指出关键的开放性研究问题。

title: Peer Effects in the Diffusion of Solar Photovoltaic Panels
abstract: Social interaction (peer) effects are recognized as a potentially important factor in the diffusion of new products. In the case of environmentally friendly goods or technologies, both marketers and policy makers are interested in the presence of causal peer effects as social spillovers can be used to expedite adoption. We provide a methodology for the simple, straightforward identification of peer effects with sufficiently rich data, avoiding the biases that occur with traditional fixed effects estimation when using the past installed base of consumers in the reference group. We study the diffusion of solar photovoltaic panels in California and find that at the average number of owner-occupied homes in a zip code, an additional installation increases the probability of an adoption in the zip code by 0.78 percentage points. Our results provide valuable guidance to marketers designing strategies to increase referrals and reduce customer acquisition costs. They also provide insights into the diffusion process of environmentally friendly technologies.
abstract_zh: 社会互动（同伴）效应被认为是新产品扩散中一个潜在的重要因素。就环保商品或技术而言，营销人员和政策制定者都关注是否存在因果性的同伴效应，因为社会溢出可以用来加速采用。在数据足够丰富的前提下，我们提供了一种简单直接的同伴效应识别方法，避免了在使用参照群体中消费者以往安装存量时，传统固定效应估计所产生的偏误。我们研究了加利福尼亚州太阳能光伏板的扩散，发现在邮政编码区平均的自有住房数量下，每增加一套安装，该邮政编码区采用的概率就提高0.78个百分点。我们的结果为设计增加推荐并降低客户获取成本策略的营销人员提供了宝贵指导。它们也为环保技术的扩散过程提供了见解。

title: Split Incentives in Residential Energy Consumption
abstract: We explore two split incentive issues between owners and occupants of residential dwellings: heating or cooling incentives are suboptimal when the occupant does not pay for energy use, and insulation incentives are suboptimal when the occupant cannot perfectly observe the owner’s insulation choice. We empirically quantify the effect of these two market failures and how they affect behavior in California. We find that those who pay are 16 percent more likely to change the heating setting at night and owner-occupied dwellings are 20 percent more likely to be insulated in the attic or ceiling. However, in contrast to common conception, we find that only small overall energy savings may be possible from policy interventions aimed at correcting the split incentive issues.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了住宅业主与居住者之间的两种激励分离问题：当居住者不为能源使用付费时，供暖或制冷的激励并非最优；当居住者无法完全观察到业主的保温决策时，保温激励也非最优。我们实证量化了这两种市场失灵的效应，以及它们如何影响加州的居民行为。我们发现，付费的居住者在夜间调整供暖设定的可能性高出16%，而自住住宅的阁楼或天花板保温的可能性高出20%。然而，与普遍看法相反，我们发现，旨在纠正激励分离问题的政策干预，其带来的总体能源节约可能很小。

title: Economic Impact of the Integration of Alternative Vehicle Technologies into the New Zealand Vehicle Fleet
Market Failure and the Structure of Externalities
Assessment of Primary Impacts of a Hydrogen Economy in New Zealand using UNISYD
Economic Efficiency of Solar Hot Water Policy in New Zealand
Energy Efficiency Economics and Policy
abstract: Energy efficiency and conservation are considered key means for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving other energy policy goals, but associated market behavior and policy responses have engendered debates in the economic literature. We review economic concepts underlying consumer decision making in energy efficiency and conservation and examine related empirical literature. In particular, we provide an economic perspective on the range of market barriers, market failures, and behavioral failures that have been cited in the energy efficiency context. We assess the extent to which these conditions provide a motivation for policy intervention in energy-using product markets, including an examination of the evidence on policy effectiveness and cost. Although theory and empirical evidence suggests there is potential for welfare-enhancing energy efficiency policies, many open questions remain, particularly relating to the extent of some key market and behavioral failures.
abstract_zh: 能效和节约能源被视为减少温室气体排放并实现其他能源政策目标的关键手段，但相关的市场行为与政策应对在经济学文献中引发了争论。我们回顾了能效与节能领域消费者决策背后的经济学概念，并考察了相关的实证文献。特别是，我们从经济学视角梳理了能效领域中被提及的一系列市场障碍、市场失灵和行为失灵。我们评估了这些条件在多大程度上为能源使用产品市场的政策干预提供了依据，包括考察有关政策有效性和成本的证据。尽管理论和实证证据表明，能效政策有可能提升福利，但仍有许多悬而未决的问题，特别是关于某些关键市场失灵和行为失灵的程度。

title: Learning-by-Doing and the Optimal Solar Policy in California
abstract: Much policy attention has been given to promote fledgling energy technologies that promise to reduce our reliance onfossilfuels. These policies often aim to correct market failures, such as environmental externalities and learning-by-doing (LBD). We examine the implications of the assumption that LBD exists, quantifying the market failure due to LBD. We develop a model of technological advancement based on LBD and environmental market failures to examine the economically efficient level of subsidies in California’s solar photovoltaic market. Under central-case parameter estimates, including nonappropriable LBD, we find that maximizing net social benefits implies a solar subsidy schedule similar in magnitude to the recently implemented California Solar Initiative. This result holds for a wide range of LBD parameters. However, with no LBD, the subsidies cannot be justified by the environmental externality alone.
abstract_zh: 许多政策关注都致力于推动尚处于起步阶段的能源技术，这些技术有望减少我们对化石燃料的依赖。此类政策通常旨在纠正市场失灵，例如环境外部性和边干边学（learning-by-doing，LBD）。我们检验了边干边学存在这一假设的含义，并量化了边干边学所导致的市场失灵。我们构建了一个基于边干边学和环境市场失灵的技术进步模型，以考察加州太阳能光伏市场中经济上有效率的补贴水平。在包括不可占用型边干边学在内的中心情景参数估计下，我们发现，使净社会福利最大化意味着一条补贴路径，其规模与近期实施的加州太阳能计划（California Solar Initiative）相近。这一结论在边干边学参数的广泛取值范围内都成立。然而，若不存在边干边学，仅凭环境外部性无法为这些补贴提供正当性。

Economies of Scale in Community Water Systems
venue: Journal of American Water Works Association
abstract: Data sets from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's 1995 and 2000 Community Water Systems surveys were used to examine the production costs of water supply systems. The authors estimate water supply economies of scale by estimating the elasticities of both the total unit cost and the individual component costs. For total unit cost, they found that a 1% production increase reduced unit costs by a statistically significant 0.16%. For individual component costs, higher economies of scale in capital, materials, outside services, and other costs and lower, but still positive, economies of scale in labor and energy costs were found. These economies of scale may reflect production economies or suggest that larger systems are better than smaller systems at bargaining and receiving services and materials at a lower unit cost. Importantly, bargaining gains and some production economies do not necessarily depend on water systems becoming physically interconnected.
abstract_zh: 本文使用美国环境保护署（EPA）1995年和2000年社区供水系统调查的数据，考察供水系统的生产成本。作者通过估计总单位成本及各分项成本的弹性，来估算供水的规模经济。对于总单位成本，产量每增加1%，单位成本在统计上显著下降0.16%。对于各分项成本，资本、材料、外包服务及其他成本的规模经济更为显著，而劳动和能源成本的规模经济较低，但仍为正。这些规模经济可能反映了生产上的经济性，也可能表明较大的系统在议价以及以更低单位成本获取服务和材料方面优于较小的系统。重要的是，议价收益和部分生产经济性并不一定依赖于供水系统之间的实体互联。

title: Energy Efficiency Policies: A Retrospective Examination
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources
abstract: ▪ Abstract  We review literature on several types of energy efficiency policies: appliance standards, financial incentive programs, information and voluntary programs, and management of government energy use. For each, we provide a brief synopsis of the relevant programs, along with available existing estimates of energy savings, costs, and cost-effectiveness at a national level. The literature examining these estimates points to potential issues in determining the energy savings and costs, but recent evidence suggests that techniques for measuring both have improved. Taken together, the literature identifies up to four quads of energy savings annually from these programs—at least half of which is attributable to appliance standards and utility-based demand-side management, with possible additional energy savings from the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE's) ENERGY STAR, Climate Challenge, and Section 1605b voluntary programs to reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. Related reductions in CO2and criteria air pollutants may contribute an additional 10% to the value of energy savings above the price of energy itself.
abstract_zh: ▪ 摘要 本文回顾了几类能源效率政策的文献：家电能效标准、财政激励计划、信息与自愿性计划，以及政府能源使用管理。针对每一类政策，我们简要概述相关计划，并给出现有文献在全国层面对节能量、成本和成本效益的估计。考察这些估计的文献指出，在确定节能量和成本方面存在潜在问题，但近期证据表明，两者的测量技术均已有所改进。综合来看，文献表明这些计划每年可带来多达四个quad（四千万亿英热单位）的节能量，其中至少一半归因于家电能效标准和基于公用事业的需求侧管理；美国能源部（DOE）的ENERGY STAR、Climate Challenge和第1605(b)节自愿性计划还可能带来额外的节能，从而减少二氧化碳（CO2）排放。与二氧化碳及常规大气污染物相关的减排，可能使节能的价值在能源价格本身之上再增加10%。

title: Choosing Congestion Pricing Policy: Cordon Tolls vs. Link-Based Tolls
abstract: Marginal cost pricing has been long advocated as an efficient way of distributing scarce road resources. In practice, however, policy makers have to retreat to second-best pricing schemes that are associated with lower transaction costs and are simpler for potential users to understand than the first-best marginal cost tolls. To date, the majority of practical applications and theoretical models in Europe and Asia are represented by cordon or area pricing mechanisms, while in North America, variations of link-based tolls have become dominant. This paper compares welfare effects of two second-best cordon pricing schemes with those of second-best link-based tolls for the Washington, D.C., transportation network. START, a strategic and regional transport planning model that features elastic travel demands as well as mode, time period, and route choice, is used to analyze the impacts of the two pricing approaches. Distributional effects of cordon and link-based tolls are also examined in the hope of understanding why one scheme might be preferred over another. Because Washington, D.C., in many respects resembles a European city, cordon policies are more likely to be effective there than in more typical North American cities. Although overall net welfare benefits achieved by the three schemes are found to be similar, their dependence on revenue recycling and distributional impacts are quite different. Although the small cordon puts a higher share of costs on low-income travelers than do other pricing schemes, in absolute terms these costs are lower. The exact distributional impact of a larger cordon is uncertain because it depends on the revenue recycling method employed.
abstract_zh: 边际成本定价长期以来被倡导为分配稀缺道路资源的一种有效方式。然而在实践中，政策制定者不得不退而采用次优定价方案，这些方案交易成本较低，且比一阶最优的边际成本收费更易于潜在使用者理解。迄今为止，欧洲和亚洲的大多数实际应用与理论模型都以环线（cordon）或区域定价机制为代表，而在北美，各种基于路段的收费方式已占主导地位。本文比较了华盛顿特区交通网络中两种次优环线定价方案与次优路段收费方案的福利效应。START是一个战略性区域交通规划模型，其特点是包含弹性出行需求以及出行方式、时段和路线选择，本文利用该模型分析两种定价方式的影响。我们还考察了环线收费与路段收费的分配效应，以期理解为何某一方案可能优于另一方案。由于华盛顿特区在许多方面与欧洲城市相似，环线政策在那里可能比在更典型的北美城市更为有效。尽管三种方案实现的总体净福利收益相近，但它们对收入再循环的依赖以及分配影响却大不相同。虽然小型环线使低收入出行者承担的成本份额高于其他定价方案，但以绝对值计，这些成本较低。较大环线的确切分配影响并不确定，因为它取决于所采用的收入再循环方式。
